items.prompt:
Read the passage.

First, Leo put on his coat. Next, he pulled on his boots. Then he went out to play in the snow.

What did Leo do first?
A) Went out to play
B) Put on his coat
C) Pulled on his boots
D) Ate breakfast

steps: Look for the word "First."
The passage says, "First, Leo put on his coat."
So the answer is B.

items.prompt:

The wind blew very hard. Because the wind was so strong, the kite flew high into the sky.

WHY did the kite fly high?
A) Because it was raining
B) Because the wind was strong
C) Because it was night
D) Because it was small
items.answer: B) Because the wind was strong

steps: The word "Because" points to the cause.
The passage says, "Because the wind was so strong, the kite flew high."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Because the wind was strong

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

A chick hatches in steps. First, it pecks a small crack in the shell. Next, it pushes hard against the shell. Then the shell breaks open and the chick comes out.

What happens right after the chick pecks a crack in the shell?
A) The shell breaks open
B) The chick pushes hard against the shell
C) The chick lays an egg
D) The chick flies away
items.answer: B) The chick pushes hard against the shell

steps: Look for what comes "Next" after the peck.
The passage says, "Next, it pushes hard against the shell."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) The chick pushes hard against the shell

The class left the window open all night. Because rain blew in, the papers on the desk got soaked. As a result, the teacher hung them up to dry in the morning.

WHAT was the result of the papers getting soaked?
A) The window closed by itself
B) The teacher hung them up to dry
C) The rain stopped
D) The class went home
items.answer: B) The teacher hung them up to dry

steps: Look for the effect after "As a result."
The passage says, "As a result, the teacher hung them up to dry."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) The teacher hung them up to dry

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Long ago, people told time in different ways. First, they used sundials that needed sunlight. Then someone invented the water clock, which worked even at night. Later, people built clocks with gears that were far more exact.

Which invention came after the sundial but before the gear clock?
A) The gear clock
B) The water clock
C) The wristwatch
D) The sundial

steps: Follow the time order: sundial, then water clock, later gear clock.
After the sundial, "Then someone invented the water clock."
The gear clock came later, so the answer is B.

Beavers build a dam across a stream. Because the dam blocks the flowing water, the water backs up and forms a deep pond. As a result, fish, ducks, and other animals come to live in the new pond.

WHY does a deep pond form behind the dam?
A) Because the dam blocks the flowing water
B) Because it rains every day
C) Because fish dig the pond
D) Because the stream dries up
items.answer: A) Because the dam blocks the flowing water

steps: The word "Because" points to the cause.
The passage says the dam "blocks the flowing water," so "the water backs up and forms a deep pond."
So the answer is A.
solution.answer: A) Because the dam blocks the flowing water

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

A town near the coast planted a thick row of trees along the shore. Before the trees, strong ocean winds blew sand over the roads and homes. After the trees grew tall, they blocked much of the wind, so far less sand reached the town. As a result, the roads stayed clear.

Which sentence best describes the relationship between the trees and the clear roads?
A) The trees blocked the wind, so less sand blew in and the roads stayed clear
B) The roads were built before the trees
C) The sand made the trees grow taller
D) The wind planted the trees
items.answer: A) The trees blocked the wind, so less sand blew in and the roads stayed clear

steps: Follow the cause and effect chain.
The trees "blocked much of the wind, so far less sand reached the town."
As a result the roads stayed clear, so the answer is A.
solution.answer: A) The trees blocked the wind, so less sand blew in and the roads stayed clear

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

The steps to make bread must go in order. First, yeast is mixed into the dough, and it makes tiny bubbles of gas. Next, those bubbles make the dough rise and grow puffy. Then the dough is baked, and the heat sets it into a light, airy loaf. If the yeast were left out, the bread would come out flat and hard.

Why would leaving out the yeast make the bread flat?
A) The oven would be too cold
B) Without yeast there are no gas bubbles to make the dough rise
C) The dough would be too wet
D) The bread would bake too fast
items.answer: B) Without yeast there are no gas bubbles to make the dough rise

steps: Find the cause of the rising dough.
The yeast "makes tiny bubbles of gas" that "make the dough rise."
Without yeast there would be no bubbles, so the bread stays flat, answer B.
solution.answer: B) Without yeast there are no gas bubbles to make the dough rise
